faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Mahadayi PRAWAH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 27 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Mahadayi PRAWAH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Member (Environmental Issues), 1 Member (Hydrology), 1 Member (Monitoring and Regulation), 1 Director (Finance).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Mahadayi PRAWAH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Bio-data proforma in Annexure-V of this notice) and send it to The Under Secretary (Estt. IV), Department of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti, Room No. 435, Shram Shakti Bhavan, Rafi Marg, New Delhi, by through proper channel, and by email, to reach by 27 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Member (Environmental Issues): maximum 58 years; Member (Hydrology): maximum 58 years; Member (Monitoring and Regulation): maximum 58 years; Director (Finance): maximum 56 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay Matrix Level-14 (Rs.144200-218200) for Member (Environmental Issues), Pay Matrix Level-14 (Rs.1,44,200-2,18,200 ) for Member (Hydrology), Pay Matrix Level-14 (Rs.1,44,200-2,18,200 ) for Member (Monitoring and Regulation), Pay Matrix Level-13 (Rs.1,23,100-2,15,900 ) for Director (Finance).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Serving officers holding an analogous post or with the required regular service in the specified Pay Matrix level. Members: Degree in Engineering in the relevant field plus 15 years' experience. Director (Finance): Bachelor's degree in any discipline plus 10 years' experience in finance, accounts, audit and budget. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only serving officers of Central/State Governments, UTs, recognized research institutions, universities, PSUs, semi-government, autonomous or statutory organizations may apply.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Director (Finance): officers from the beneficiary States Karnataka, Maharashtra and Goa.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation basis.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation (including short-term contract) basis. Term in Mahadayi PRAWAH not exceeding three years (Director (Finance): three years) or till superannuation, whichever is earlier. Deputation period including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation shall ordinarily not exceed 5 years.
